logo.label: Logo
logo.info: Upload the official MAYDAN logo (transparent PNG or SVG). Do not modify its proportions.

logo_light.label: Logo — light version (over hero)
logo_light.info: Optional light logo shown over the transparent hero header. Falls back to the main logo.

favicon.label: Favicon
favicon.info: Will be scaled down to 32 x 32 px

colors.name: Colors

background_gradient.label: Background gradient
background_gradient.info: Optional. Replaces the solid background where supported.

colors.brand_accents_info: MAYDAN brand palette — Black #090909, Bone #EEE9DF, Charcoal #181818, Muted red #A31E27, Grey #A7A39B. Keep black and bone dominant; use red only for small accents, buttons, hovers and promo banners.

accent_red.label: Muted red accent
accent_red.info: Used for small accents, sale badges, promo banners and hover states.

heading_font.label: Heading font
heading_font.info: Use a bold, condensed typeface for the aggressive editorial look (e.g. Archivo Narrow, Oswald).

new_badge_tag.label: New badge product tag
new_badge_tag.info: Products with this tag show a NEW badge.

free_shipping_threshold.label: Free-shipping threshold
free_shipping_threshold.info: Set to match your Shopify shipping settings. This is display only — configure the real rate in Settings → Shipping.

image.label: Default social sharing image
image.info: Used for Open Graph / Twitter cards when a page has no image. 1200 x 630 px recommended.

title_suffix.label: Title tag suffix
title_suffix.info: Appended to page titles, e.g. "| MAYDAN Fightwear".

analytics.name: Analytics & marketing
analytics.info: Enter IDs to enable tracking. Scripts load asynchronously and never block rendering. For most stores, prefer Shopify's built-in Google & Meta channels; use these fields only if you manage tags directly.

klaviyo.label: Klaviyo public API key
klaviyo.info: Enables Klaviyo onsite. Leave blank to use Shopify Email instead.

analytics.custom_info: Google Merchant Center, Meta catalog and TikTok Shop catalogs are configured in Shopify Admin → Sales channels. Product structured data is already output for Merchant Center.

reveal_on_scroll.label: Reveal sections on scroll
reveal_on_scroll.info: Subtle fade-up. Automatically disabled for visitors who prefer reduced motion.
